name: port-nosignal-v1
summary: Declare an input port "no signal" after 200 x 20 ms = 4.0 s instead of 8-10 s (faster automatic input scan and "No signal")
status: superseded by port-nosignal (v2): v1 also shortened USB-C (port 0) to 4 s; USB-C wakes through a dock then showed "No signal" (2026-10-07)

edits.asm: sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x1f4 -> ori r5,r0,0xc8 (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type bit3/4/0x400, normal case)
sub_260E0E ori r5,r0,0x190 -> ori r5,r0,0xc8 (port +0x1A no-signal threshold, type 0x20, normal case)

notes: Port +0x1A thresholds set by sub_260E0E (vendor: 400 passes for type 0x20, 500 for types bit3/4/0x400, 200 in the flag case). LG 28MQ780 uses 100. Accept thresholds (+0x18, see port-accept) unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_port_nosignal.py (NOSIG=n, 50-255).
